fixture_contract: One explicit list of60 cases, one pass each; no hidden products/parameterization/fuzz/discovery.

The enumerated Bash cases execute the actual production shell body with inert command stubs and a fake absolute pinned-executable stub. Stub bytes/argv/log schemas are frozen before testing; do not rewrite production logic or use a production bypass flag.
Bash cases prove builtin/control-flow/argv behavior only, not real command availability, cache contents, TLS, fsync or deadline enforcement. T060 is static only.
No historical/Worker36/policy imports, fixture constructors, evaluators, games, real runner process probes or live HTTP occur in native tests.
T053-T056 consistently re-pin the mutated synthetic outer ZIP length/hash and mock artifact digest before their target deeper check; unrelated/report pins remain fixed as stated.
T057 is only P07 pull-request.json persistence; do not expand it over multiple phases.
Any budget detection byte counts within16MiB aggregate response-body bytes; do not describe these counts as wire traffic.
Mock storage URLs use synthetic worker37fixture.blob.core.windows.net only under disabled live networking; this is not an observed provider account.

T006 and T038 run the actual fresh P02 workflow shell block and actual launcher, not a stand-in. Repeat sanitation at each fresh shell boundary. Seventeen Bash cases is a case count, not a physical process count.

Descriptor SHA256 and completed-body SHA256 are bound outside the hashed objects in the final root freeze record; descriptor references only an earlier immutable preregistration identity, never that final record hash.
